description: "Surround yourself with solar rays, dealing |cffffff6400|r Magic Damage to nearby enemies and applying Minor Maim to them for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing their damage done by |cffffff5|r%.\n\nThe rays then protect you, granting a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff6802|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds, increasing by |cffffff10|r% for each enemy hit, up to |cffffff60|r%. This portion of the ability scales off your Max Health."
